The game received mostly positive reviews from critics, who praised the improvements over the original, as well as the multiplayer and minigames, but criticized the lack of originality, while graphics received a mixed to positive response. DC:next-tetris-on-line-edition.d: The Next Tetris is a puzzle video game in the Tetris series, developed by Blue Planet Software. In 2000, a version for the Dreamcast called The Next Tetris: On-Line Edition, which included online multiplayer, was published by Crave Entertainment in the United States. The Dreamcast version was released in Europe the following year with online functionality removed.
